morphology.pattern_note: 作为英语专名整体识别；通常读一个音节。词尾 s 不能按马来语词缀分析，也不能自动解释为英语复数。

senses.zh_definition: Hayes：可用作姓氏或地名的专名，通常音译为“海斯”；具体所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A proper name used as a surname or place name, with its referent determined by context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan sebagai nama keluarga atau nama tempat; rujukannya ditentukan oleh konteks.
senses.nuances: 规范书写通常首字母大写。它不是可直接译成某个普通马来语概念的通用名词。以下为姓氏语境中的示例搭配，并非经频率统计确认的搭配。

dual_scenarios.ms: Encik Hayes akan membentangkan laporan tersebut dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 海斯先生将在明天的会议上汇报该报告。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Hayes will present the report at tomorrow's meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Encik Hayes sudah tiba di lobi.
dual_scenarios.zh: 海斯先生已经到大堂了。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr Hayes is already in the lobby.

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Encik Hayes dah sampai kat lobi ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Encik Hayes sudah tiba di lobi?
messages.en: Has Mr Hayes arrived in the lobby?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Saya nak turun jemput dia sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, beliau sudah tiba. Saya akan turun untuk menyambut beliau sekarang.
messages.en: Yes. I'm going down to meet him now.

etymology.historical_story: Hayes has more than one family-name origin. English histories include connections with places named Hayes and with vegetation-covered land. Consequently, a shared spelling does not prove a shared ancestry. In a Malay text, the name normally identifies a person or place; its historical meaning is not translated into the sentence. [Dictionary of American Family Names via Ancestry](https://www.ancestry.co.uk/last-name-meaning/Hayes)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Hayes 常读 /heɪz/，可用“海斯先生”的人物画面记住：这是姓名，不能拆成 hay 加复数 s。
